name: Select
summary: Pick one value (or several) from a known set — with type-to-search — rendered through the shared Select.
highlights: Pick one value or several from a known set
lead: Select carries a popup, a virtualised list, search and tagging — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared selectTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Error message
spec.value: <aha-field-error icon> below the control, 4px gap · 12×12 system-x-circle + text at --aha-size-sm 12/18 · #1A1A1A

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height 24 / 40 / 48 (large also sets the trigger text to 16px on a 24px line); touch is 56 with 16px text and 16px side padding (the audience phone now uses lg)

props.name: error message
props.desc: Pair status="error" with a sibling <aha-field-error icon message="…"> below the control (12px glyph + --aha-size-sm text) and set aria-invalid="true" + aria-describedby="<error id>" on the control

props.name: allowClear
props.desc: Show an × to clear the selection

whenToUse.when: one value from a known set of more than ~5 options — don't make the user type it
2–5 mutually-exclusive options all worth showing at once
free text that isn't a known set

opinion.note: Pre-select the recommended default rather than leaving it empty. Keep option labels short and sentence case; for long lists keep showSearch on. For a short, known set (or a select inside a shadow-DOM surface like a settings row) reach for the leaf Select field (slug `select-field`, <aha-select>) instead — this composite is for search / tags / multi / virtualised lists.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 Select themed by selectTheme; matrix: size (small 24 / default 40 / large 48) × status (—/error #1A1A1A/warning #1A1A1A) × mode (single/multiple/tags) × allowClear · disabled · loading, plus showSearch and placeholder. Verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 Select set (Select, Form-Item/Select, Form-Item/Select-Multiple, Input-Addon/Select-Single) on fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy. Not yet exposed: prefix/suffix adornments and option groups (optGroup) — real follow-up.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared selectTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (selectTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 selector bound to selectTheme.
